summary: Postinstall and require-time beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall script (beacon.cjs) and a main entry (index.js) that both invoke a beacon POSTing the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, and node version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The destination is a bare IPv4 on a non-standard port, unrelated to any publisher infrastructure. The package has no advertised functionality: main exports a Proxy of no-op functions so that bundlers and consumers do not crash on property access, while the require-time path and the postinstall hook both exist solely to trigger the callback. The package self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim' with no legitimate reason to phone home, and the generic @greenlake/context-pane name combined with the no-op export surface is consistent with a dependency-confusion lure whose only effect on installers is the install-time and import-time beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
